entries.title: A weekly email, from Sunday evening
entries.what: Each week a short summary lands in all three of our inboxes: where the roadmap stands, the meetings logged with their decisions and action items, files added, what was posted on the board, and what is new in the hub.

entries.title: Mike hears about it right away
entries.what: When one of us sends a suggestion, uploads a file, logs a meeting, posts on the board or changes a roadmap status, Mike gets an email about it, usually within the hour. Changes can happen during the week instead of waiting for the next meeting.

entries.title: Safe to use at the same time
entries.what: If two of us post on the board, change a roadmap status, or log or remove a meeting at the same moment, everything now saves. Before, whoever saved second could quietly wipe out what the other had just added.

entries.title: What's new
entries.what: This list. Whenever something is added to the hub it shows up here with what it does, and a dot appears next to Guide in the menu until you have seen it.

entries.title: Suggest a change, from any page
entries.what: There is a box at the bottom of every page. Write what you want changed or added and send it. It lands in the queue on Our RoadMap, where all three of us can see it. Mike builds it, and it clears itself from the queue once it is done or we decide to pass.
